# External monitor evaluation sample

`monitor_mitylernal_cc0.ply` is an external point-cloud sample for
qualitative upload and inference testing.

- Original asset: [Low-poly Monitor](https://opengameart.org/content/low-poly-monitor)
- Creator: Mitylernal
- License: CC0
- Derived file: 4,096-point PLY exported from the original mesh

This sample is not part of ModelNet10 and was not used for training,
validation, model selection, or the reported test metrics. It is included
only as an out-of-distribution example for manually testing the web upload
and classification workflow.
